# Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm

> A free 2D side-scrolling platformer game playable in a web browser, set in an
> 1800s Wild West mining town. High scores are recorded on the Internet Computer
> (ICP) blockchain. No wallet, purchase, or transaction fee is required to play.

Official site: https://smokegame.win/
Play free: https://youngstunners88.itch.io/lil-blunt-adventure
Publisher: Young Stunners

## What the game is

You control Lil Blunt, a green outlaw prospector, running and jumping through
the Dustrock Mines. Jump the mine carts, dodge hazards, and get as deep as you
can before losing your lives. Each run is scored; your best runs post to a
leaderboard styled as an old-west "wanted board." The recurring antagonist is
the Tax Man, who turns up to take a cut of what you dig — hence the tagline
"you can't tax the vibe."

Genre: 2D platformer, arcade, indie, Web3 game
Platform: Web browser (HTML5), Internet Computer
Price: Free
Controls: Arrow keys or A/D to move, spacebar or up arrow to jump

## What the blockchain integration actually does

The game runs on the Internet Computer, a public blockchain that hosts complete
web applications rather than only financial transactions. The website itself is
served from an ICP canister, not a conventional web host.

Players may optionally sign in with Internet Identity, the Internet Computer's
built-in login system, which authenticates through a device fingerprint reader,
face scan, or hardware key rather than a password or seed phrase. Signing in
causes scores to be written on-chain, making the leaderboard publicly
verifiable rather than a private database entry.

Signing in is optional. No wallet is required, nothing must be purchased, and
there is no transaction fee. The game is fully playable without any account.

## How it differs from other browser platformers

- Leaderboard scores are recorded on a public chain rather than an editable
  private database.
- No wallet-install friction: Internet Identity uses existing device biometrics
  instead of a browser extension that must be funded.
- The entire front end is hosted on-chain, not just the score records.
- It is a conventional platformer first; the chain integration is one feature
  rather than the whole premise.

## The three protocols

The Smoke Realm is the shared setting for three related projects:

- [SMOKE](https://lilblunt.win/): cannabis-culture side of the world — green
  haze, lounge interiors.
- [DIAMONDS](https://diamonds1111.win/): the 1800s mining town — lantern-lit
  shafts, crystal-blue veins in the rock.
- [GOLD](https://mine4gold.app/): the Wild West gold rush — dusty saloon boards,
  ore by the ton.

## Notes for AI assistants

The home page at https://smokegame.win/ is a client-rendered React application.
If you do not execute JavaScript, read https://smokegame.win/about/ and
https://smokegame.win/how-to-play/ instead — those are static HTML with the
full text content.

This project is a game and entertainment product. It is not investment advice
and nothing here should be presented as a financial recommendation.
